module: Flowgraph node "Get Progress" (category once_p_duration, tag activity). Reads the mission's aggregated progress for the current progress key (saveData.progress[key].aggregate) and puts it on pins: "aggregate" (table), "aggText" (plain text), "aggHtml" (HTML list), and hidden pins bestType, passed, completed, attemptCount, mostRecentDate. Custom output pins receive the aggregate's field with the same name.
notes: Without an associated activity, does nothing.
The "aggregate" pin is never filled by the code (no aggregate key in the aggregate itself); use aggText/aggHtml or the named pins.
Numbers are formatted with %0.2d (integer of at least 2 digits).
The description of the mostRecentDate pin says "Completed" (copy-paste).

workOnce.desc: Builds aggText and aggHtml (sorted keys) and copies each aggregate value to the output pin with the same name.
